Viking Herja Review

Review of Viking Herja

The 2016-built Longship Viking Herja cruises on the Rhine and Moselle rivers in France, Germany, and Switzerland, departing from homeports Trier (Germany) and Basel (Switzerland).

This Viking longship is named after Herja, a mighty valkyrie from Old Norse mythology. Valkyries (Valkyria, translated as “chooser of the slain”) are female mythological figures who determine who lives and who dies on the battlefield.

Viking Herja features an innovative corridor configuration (patented design), modern engineering and technology, signature Scandinavian-themed decor, premium stateroom amenities, an itinerary-based and expert-led enrichment program, themed onboard entertainment, efficient use of public spaces, the signature Aquavit Terrace lounge, and numerous cabins with step-out balconies. Each Viking Longship also features two of the European river cruise industry’s largest suites.

The vessel (ENI number 7002059) is currently Switzerland-flagged (MMSI 269057587) and registered in Basel.

Cabins

Viking Herja has a total of 95 cabins (including 9 Suites, 22 French Balcony staterooms, and 25 with non-opening windows) across 8 grades.

Cabin types/categories (number, location), from highest to lowest:

  • Suites - ES (x2, Deck 3), AA (x7, Deck 3)
  • Balcony Staterooms - A (x20, Deck 3), B (x17, Deck 2)
  • French Balcony Staterooms (with floor-to-ceiling glass doors) - C (x5, Deck 3), D (x15, Deck 2)
  • RiverView Staterooms - E (x18, Deck 1), F (x7, Deck 1).

Shipboard facilities

Viking Herja dining options include the Herja Restaurant (main dining room) and Aquavit Terrace (alfresco dining venue). Other facilities include the Observation Lounge, Atrium (lobby), Library (Internet area), and Shop (gifts and souvenirs). The top deck features a shaded relaxation area, Sky Bar, herb garden, putting green, walking track, and shuffleboard. The Herja Longship does not have a fitness/gym room, swimming pool, jacuzzi, or spa.

Viking Herja river cruise deals include Internet (Wi-Fi), all tours/excursions, ground transfers, room service, live evening entertainment, daily lectures, food and wine tastings, 24-hour coffee and tea, and replenished daily bottled water.

Viking Herja river cruise prices are per person and based on double occupancy. These rates are indicative and may vary depending on travel agency promotions, special offers, discounts, group bookings, or last-minute deals. On select itineraries and departure dates, Viking may offer discounted round-trip USA airfare (on selected cabins or cruise tours).

River Cruise Itineraries

The following are Viking Herja river cruise itineraries by theme, as officially announced by Viking Cruises:

  • "PARIS TO THE SWISS ALPS" is a 12-day Rhine and Moselle cruise starting from Paris. These itineraries include sailing on the Rhine and Moselle rivers, visits to 4 countries (France, Germany, Switzerland, Luxembourg), and 10 complimentary guided excursions.
  • The 12-day cruise tour visits 4 countries and includes hotel stays in Paris and Zurich. The Rhine-Moselle itinerary passes ancient castles, vineyards, Trier’s Roman landmarks, Lorelei Rock, and the German towns of Cochem, Mainz, and Bernkastel, as well as visits to Luxembourg City and Strasbourg.
  • These tour packages include an 8-day river cruise, two 2-night hotel stays (Le Meridien Etoile Paris and Zurich Marriott), 10 guided tours, 7 breakfasts, 6 lunches, 7 dinners, complimentary beverages (wine, beer, and soft drinks with lunch and dinner), complimentary Wi-Fi, visits to 6 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, and port charges.

Viking Herja Wiki

To/from Viking Herja boat transfers and airport meet-and-greet services are included in the cruise fares only when air travel is purchased through Viking Cruises.

Viking Herja is one of the latest-generation Viking Cruises Longships. This patented river cruise ship design allows for larger accommodations without reducing public areas or compromising overall comfort. The vessel represents the line’s latest Longship-class design, featuring energy-efficient hybrid engine technology, solar panels, and an interior by Yran & Storbraaten (Norway). The patented “longship” design (by Rottet Studios, USA) enables significantly larger accommodations with full-size balconies. The additional cabin space is achieved by shifting the deck corridor off-center by 1 m (3.3 ft).

As is traditional for Viking River Cruises, Herja’s naming ceremony was part of a group christening event. On March 7, 2017, a double christening ceremony was held, during which Viking Herja was officially named together with Viking Hild. The event took place in Germany, at the confluence of the Rhine and Mosel rivers, near the border with France.

The riverboat’s godmother is Mrs. Debbie Wiseman (British composer for film and television, conductor, and radio/TV presenter). The ceremonial bottle was Veuve Clicquot Champagne. Viking Hild’s godmother is Princess Stephanie von Brenken, wife of Prince Carl Friedrich of Lowenstein-Wertheim-Rosenberg. Princess Stephanie is also CEO of the family-owned winery “Weingut Fürst Löwenstein.” The family’s residence is featured as an exclusive (Privileged Access) Viking river cruise excursion, offering tours of the estate and winery.
